# Case and release checklists

## Before approval

- The case has an owner, a backup, a release approver, and a dated next action.
- The reporter has received an update and confirmed their credit preference.
- The maintainer has confirmed affected versions, mitigations, and fix availability. Any gaps are documented for the release decision.
- Participating teams have the release time and time zone, identifier owner, and advisory owner.
- The public draft has been reviewed for sensitive case data, including reporter details and internal references.

## At release

- Publish the vulnerability record through the agreed channel and confirm the public identifier.
- Publish the advisory with version-specific guidance and verify that the update or mitigation instructions are reachable.
- Add the identifier to the disclosure case and explicitly mark it *Disclosed* at the agreed time.
- Verify the public pages and configured distribution channels while signed out. Send links to the reporter and participating teams.

## After release

- Assign follow-up ownership and propagate corrections to the advisory and vulnerability record.
- Review time to acknowledgement, time to publication, and any missed handoffs. Record what the team will change before the next case.

See [Investigation and coordination](../investigation-and-coordination/index.qmd) and [Publish the advisory and follow up](../advisory-and-follow-up/index.qmd) for the corresponding workflows.
